reasoning_summary: Every mutation goes through one staged-copy commit over immutable nodes, which makes multi atomic and failures side-effect free; watch callbacks are queued and run after the monitor is released. Sessions expire lazily on every call from an injected clock. A seeded differential test against a naive model plus an invariant checker validated the kernel, and a lock recipe using predecessor watches and sequence-number fencing tokens was tested for fairness and stale-writer rejection.
